readerCopy.body: A campaign gathers volunteers, money, and urgency before anyone can give the goal the same name. A protest, rescue effort, creative push, or private confrontation moves on conviction while roles and measures of success remain unsettled. Mars gives the feeling force, while Neptune makes the purpose emotionally compelling and practically difficult to pin down. Under the conjunction, inspiration and action surge forward as one movement. The effort may inspire people while leaving organizers unable to explain where the money, labor, or responsibility finally belongs.
